subject.title: [Feature]: Support arbitrary workspace files in bootstrap context injection

question: Should OpenClaw accept explicitly configured custom-basename workspace files as part of the core `bootstrap-extra-files` hook contract?
rationale: The source gap is clear, but changing which workspace files enter deterministic startup context is a public config and prompt-context policy choice rather than a strict bug fix.

options.title: Approve Guarded Custom Files
options.body: Allow explicitly configured workspace-relative custom basenames through the existing hook path after the linked PR or a replacement preserves containment, size budgets, diagnostics, and session filtering.

options.title: Keep Recognized Basenames Only
options.body: Reject arbitrary bootstrap-file injection and keep custom context in existing first-class files or separate workspace conventions.

options.title: Defer To Broader Context API
options.body: Pause the linked PR and resolve custom files as part of a broader bootstrap/context-selector design.

recommendation.title: Approve Guarded Custom Files
recommendation.body: Allow explicitly configured workspace-relative custom basenames through the existing hook path after the linked PR or a replacement preserves containment, size budgets, diagnostics, and session filtering.

likelyOwner.reason: He has recent and repeated history in bootstrap context resolution and is already mentioned in the issue timeline for maintainer review routing.
